legend: KSHV/HHV8-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving lymph node. There are sheets of large neoplastic cells, some of which resemble plasmablasts.

Lymph node involvement. The tumour cells are strongly positive for IgM (<<29467>>) and latency-associated nuclear antigen (LANA) (<<29468>>), and a small subset are weakly positive for CD20 (<<29469>>). The tumour cells are negative for CD138 (<<29470>>).
